draft_en.subject: Industrial Ethernet beside Antaira - a value tier for ICO
draft_en.body:
Guten Tag,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 31 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the Industrial-Ethernet category beside Antaira, a value tier in the same DIN-rail form factor, CE/RoHS, from single units: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP unmanaged, -40 to 75 C - model STI-288GP - $57.4 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the L2 managed version (VLAN, QoS, IGMP), Marvell-based - STI-288GPM - $78.9.

One question: who is the product manager for networking at ICO?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
